# MacFarlane Property Group

> MacFarlane Property Group is a tech-driven residential and commercial property management company serving landlords in Cape Town, Mbombela and Johannesburg. Management fees sit below the 10–12% industry standard, and the service covers tenant placement and vetting, rent collection, maintenance coordination, property inspections, and full Rental Housing Act and POPIA compliance.

Contact: dean@macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za · +27711720480

## Core pages

- [Services](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/services) — Full property management: tenant management, maintenance coordination, lease administration, inspections, financial reporting, and legal & compliance.
- [Quote](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/quote) — Transparent pricing with management fees below the 10–12% industry standard; request a free, no-obligation quote.
- [Switch](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/switch) — Switch property managers in four steps, typically within 48 hours, with zero disruption to tenants.
- [About](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/about) — Founded by Dean MacFarlane on generations of family property experience.
- [Contact](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/contact) — Get a free rental assessment by phone, WhatsApp, or email.
